_readme: Projects excluded from the FULL lint lane (npm run lint:all), which is otherwise strict and green. This is deliberately NOT the affected lane's knownUnstableProjects list: that one is renewed by measurement (scripts/ci/lint-debt-measure.mjs) and answers which projects the affected lane may skip; this one answers which projects fail strict lint today, each with the finding that owns paying it down. Their per-rule debt is measured in scripts/ci/lint-debt-measurement.json, not restated here. tests/invariants/lint-quarantine-ssot.spec.ts caps the size so this cannot quietly become 'lint nothing', and keeps it a subset of the affected list.

exclusions.backend-common: Fails strict lint; measured debt in scripts/ci/lint-debt-measurement.json. Newly VISIBLE, not new: the project had no project.json, so Nx could not see it and lint never ran on it. ORPHAN-HIGH-588.
exclusions.event-bus: Fails strict lint; measured debt in scripts/ci/lint-debt-measurement.json. Same cause and same finding: no project.json meant no lint target existed to run. ORPHAN-HIGH-588.
exclusions.storage: Fails strict lint; measured debt in scripts/ci/lint-debt-measurement.json. Same cause. ORPHAN-HIGH-588.
exclusions.outbox: Fails strict lint; measured debt in scripts/ci/lint-debt-measurement.json. Same cause. ORPHAN-HIGH-588.
